G0100:

G0101:

 (ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: Deu.17:8, Zec.8:6 (פּלא ni.), Job.42:2 (בּצר ni.), al. ;]

G0103:
ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), 
 [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;]

 __(b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3. 
 † (AS)
G0104:
ἀεί, adv., 
 [in LXX: Isa.42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;] 
ever; 
__1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10.
 __2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12.

G0115:
ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ

G0165G:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, 
 [in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 
 __1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); 
__(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70;
